Implementation complete. All checks pass.

## Rust — `crates/rich-editor-auy-wasm`

**Dependencies**: added `serde` (derive) and `serde_json` to `Cargo.toml`; `Cargo.lock` updated.

**Modules** (all ≤300 lines, no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`):
- `editor.rs` — `#[wasm_bindgen] pub struct Editor` with `new`, `fromJSON`, `fromEnvelope`, `docJSON`, `stateJSON`, `version`, `schemaFingerprint`, `historyJSON`, `blocks`, `apply`, `dryRun`, `import`, `undo`, `redo`, `setSelection`, `clearHistory`.
- `dto.rs` — serde DTOs: `SelectionJson` (none/caret/text/node/table), all 12 ops (`insert_text`, `delete_range`, `split_block`, `join_backward`, `toggle_mark`, `set_block_attr`, `set_doc_attr`, `set_inline_attr`, `set_mark_attr`, `replace_document`, `replace_fragment`, `set_selection`) with camelCase+snake_case aliases, `BatchPayload`, `ImportPayload` (`base_version`/`baseVersion`, schema fingerprint).
- `ops.rs` / `stage.rs` — batch parsing, selection/table-cell decoding, document/fragment token-tree decoding, boundary-index fragment replacement, single-group staging (`Origin::Api`), and `toggle_mark` with real mark-range detection.
- `import.rs` — `document` / `fragment` / `replace` / `insert` / `ops` modes; all-or-nothing on a cloned editor; `base_version` → `stale_batch`; schema fingerprint → `schema_mismatch`; document/fragment replacement is one `Origin::Import` undo group.
- `attr.rs` — typed `AttrValue` decoding (Str/Int/Bool/Ref/Enum/List/Map/Any), attribute-id resolution by node/doc/mark, inline atom lookup, mark-range scan.
- `convert.rs` — state/applied/undo JSON (`{doc, selection, version}` plus `changes`/`history` on apply, `{applied, …}` on undo/redo), change-set, history, import report.
- `problem.rs` / `problem_map.rs` — every boundary failure is RFC 9457 `ProblemDetails` JSON (`type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance`, `code`, `suggestion`), mapping `ParseError`/`StepError`/`SelectionError`/`LimitError`/`SchemaError`/`EditError`; unknown tokens/attrs/marks get `code` + suggestion.
- `lib.rs` — all free functions switched to `Schema::full()`; stateless errors now throw problem JSON.
- `tests.rs` — 5 unit tests (op aliases, unknown ops, `baseVersion`, problem JSON, attr decoding).

## TypeScript/DOM

- `packages/ts/packages/core/mod.ts`: stateful `Editor` wrapper (constructor, `fromJSON`, `fromEnvelope`, `apply`, `dryRun`, `import`, `undo`, `redo`, `doc`, `toJSON`, `version`, `blocks`, `history`, `schemaFingerprint`, `setSelection`, `clearHistory`, `a11yTree`), full DTO types (`BatchOp`, `ImportPayload`, `ImportReport`, `EditorStateJSON`, table `CellRefJSON`), `DocumentError` now carries `type`/`status`/`detail`/`instance`/`suggestion` parsed from ProblemDetails, `A11yNode.code_language`, `StateProvider` for the DOM adapter.
- `packages/ts/packages/schema/mod.ts`: `basicSchema`/`documentSchema` removed; single `fullSchema()` with every core node + mark.
- `packages/ts/packages/dom/render.ts`: `code_language` rendered as `data-auy-language`; figure/image-block/table-caption paths covered.
- `packages/ts/packages/dom/mod.ts`: mounts any `StateProvider`.
- Tests rewritten/extended: 14 Deno tests green (stateful apply/undo/redo, atomic rejection, document/fragment import, stale batch, unknown token, selection/attrs, code language, figure/caption).
- Rebuilt `packages/ts/packages/core/wasm/*` via `./scripts/build_wasm.sh` (new `Editor` class in `.js`/`.d.ts`).
- Docs: README TS example now uses `Editor`; CHANGELOG `Removido` records removal of `basicSchema`/`documentSchema`.

## Verification (exact commands)

```
cargo clippy -p rich-editor-auy-wasm --all-targets -- -D warnings   # clean
cargo test -p rich-editor-auy-wasm --locked                          # 5 passed
cargo check -p rich-editor-auy-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --locked  # ok
cargo fmt -p rich-editor-auy-wasm -- --check                         # ok
./scripts/build_wasm.sh                                              # ok
cd packages/ts && deno task check                                    # 14 passed, fmt/lint/check ok
cd packages/ts && deno task publish:dry                              # dry run complete
./scripts/check_file_length.sh                                       # exit 0
```

Notes for Main: I made no edits to `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/**`. `cli/src/main.rs` still calls `Schema::basic()` (CLI isn't in this ticket's public WASM/TS path; it compiles). Core’s `state::Editor` exposes no `EditorState` accessor, so `command::toggle_mark` could not be reused; the WASM layer implements the same range-mark scan locally. `Selection::Table` support was added to the DTO/serialization after core introduced it.
